legacy_rows.Administrative home: Joint Politecnico di Milano / Torino honours programme
legacy_rows.Eligibility / restrictions: Selected master’s entrants in Engineering, Architecture and Design
legacy_rows.Delivery / credit / practical activity: Two-year interdisciplinary honours programme adds 30 credits alongside the master’s and develops innovation through collaborative projects. Published selection: 90 Milano and 60 Torino students.
legacy_rows.Basis for reach classification: Covers the institution’s three principal academic areas; selective university-level honours programme, not every student.
